title: Login service with a redacting JSON logger
name: Login event logging

questions.prompt: Is there a defect in how this code produces its structured login logs? If so, mark the line(s) where it is; otherwise answer that there is none.
What does the 'login.succeeded' line contain for the session field?
choices: Nothing; session is dropped because it is an object
An object with token set to "[redacted]" and the real expiresAt
The string "[redacted]" in place of the whole session

questions.prompt: Credentials.verify rejects with new Error("db timeout"). What does the caller receive and what is logged?
choices: { ok: false, reason: "unavailable" }, and an error line with err.type, err.message and err.stack
The exception propagates to the caller and nothing is logged
{ ok: false, reason: "invalid_credentials" }, and a warn line
{ ok: false, reason: "unavailable" }, and an error line whose err field is an empty object

questions.prompt: Two logins for different tenants run concurrently through the same LoginService. Can one request's log lines carry the other's tenantId?
choices: Yes, because this.log is shared across requests
No, because with() returns a new logger with a freshly built bindings object
Yes, if the second request starts before the first logs
Only for error lines, since error() adds fields
